title: Passage One
subtitle: Z 世代与可重复使用水瓶

paragraphs.en: If you thought a reusable water bottle was a plain, boring container—brought out of the cupboard only for long hikes—then you would be wrong. For Gen Z, a water bottle is both a necessity and a fashion statement. Social media are flooded with videos of tumblers (保温杯). The tag #WaterTok has 2.5 billion views on TikTok.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你以为可重复使用的水瓶只是一个朴素、乏味的容器——只有长途徒步时才会从橱柜里拿出来——那你就错了。对 Z 世代而言，水瓶既是生活必需品，也是一种时尚宣言。社交媒体上充斥着关于保温杯的视频。TikTok 上的 #WaterTok 话题标签已有 25 亿次浏览量。

paragraphs.en: Youngsters connect their water bottles “to their clothing and to their lifestyle”, says Matt Navarro, global president of Stanley 1913, a leading brand. They decorate their cups with all kinds of accessories, including stickers and keychains. Some buy straps, snack trays and backpacks for their water bottles.
paragraphs.zh: “年轻人将自己的水瓶与穿着、生活方式联系起来，”知名品牌 Stanley 1913 的全球总裁马特·纳瓦罗说。他们用各种配饰装饰杯子，包括贴纸和钥匙扣。有些人还专门为水瓶购买背带、零食托盘和背包。

paragraphs.en: To cater to market demand, many companies have launched water bottles in all sorts of colors. Meanwhile, they have released collections with pop singers or movie stars. Notably, on July 14th, Stanley announced a new range with Lionel Messi, a famous Argentine footballer. Once released, this collection received a warm response from the market and was highly favored by consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 为迎合市场需求，许多公司推出了各种颜色的水瓶。与此同时，它们还与流行歌手或电影明星合作推出联名系列。值得注意的是，7 月 14 日，Stanley 宣布与阿根廷著名足球运动员莱昂内尔·梅西合作推出新系列。该系列一经发布便获得了热烈的市场反响，深受消费者青睐。

paragraphs.en: The young people’s fondness for “self-care” helps explain the flood of interest, as many believe that water is the secret to glowing skin and mental sharpness. This has led to people drinking more, a trend called “hydration inflation”. Stanley’s most popular cup holds 1,200 millilitres of life-sustaining liquid. The over-the-top promotion is satisfying brands’ thirst for profit: the value of sales of portable water bottles in America reached $4 billion in the year ending in May 2025; some 270 million containers were sold in the country, up from 240 million two years ago.
paragraphs.zh: 年轻人对“自我关怀”的热衷有助于解释这股热潮，因为许多人相信，喝水是让皮肤焕发光彩、头脑保持敏锐的秘诀。这促使人们喝更多的水，形成了被称为“补水通胀”的趋势。Stanley 最受欢迎的杯子能装下 1,200 毫升维持生命所需的液体。这样夸张的营销正满足品牌对利润的渴望：截至 2025 年 5 月的一年里，美国便携式水瓶的销售额达到 40 亿美元；美国售出了约 2.7 亿个此类容器，而两年前为 2.4 亿个。

paragraphs.en: Drinking fashions ebb (衰退) and flow. In the late 1970s bottled water became the cool thing in America, notes James Salzman, the author of a book about drinking water. Luxury brands sprang up; by the 2000s celebrities were naming their favourites. Rumours spread that singer Mariah Carey bathed in French mineral water. (She actually takes her baths in milk.) Backed by high-profile endorsement, the products saw a dramatic rise in sales.
paragraphs.zh: 饮水风尚总是潮起潮落。关于饮用水的一本书的作者詹姆斯·萨尔兹曼指出，20 世纪 70 年代末，瓶装水在美国开始成为时髦之物。奢侈品牌纷纷涌现；到了 21 世纪头十年，名人开始公开自己最喜欢的品牌。有传言说，歌手玛丽亚·凯莉用法国矿泉水洗澡。（实际上，她用牛奶泡澡。）在知名人士代言的推动下，这类产品的销量大幅增长。

paragraphs.en: Gen Z is an eco-conscious group. Yet the reusable-cup trend is more about style than sustainability.
paragraphs.zh: Z 世代是一个具有环保意识的群体。然而，可重复使用水杯的流行更多关乎时尚风格，而不是可持续发展。

questions.en: What do we learn about water bottles from the first paragraph?
questions.zh: 从第一段中我们了解到关于水瓶的什么信息？

options.en: They are dull and unnecessary for Gen Z.
options.zh: 对于 Z 世代来说，水瓶既乏味又没有必要。

options.en: They are plain and boring for the seniors.
options.zh: 对于老年人来说，水瓶朴素而无趣。

options.en: They are only used for people’s long hikes.
options.zh: 水瓶只在人们长途徒步时才会使用。

options.en: They have become a trend on social media.
options.zh: 水瓶已经成为社交媒体上的一种流行趋势。

questions.explanation: 第一段指出，Z 世代把水瓶视作时尚宣言，社交媒体上充斥着保温杯相关视频，#WaterTok 获得大量浏览。因此 D 符合文意；A、B、C 是文章开头被否定的旧印象。
questions.evidence: For Gen Z, a water bottle is both a necessity and a fashion statement. Social media are flooded with videos of tumblers (保温杯).

questions.en: How do companies respond to the market demand for water bottles?
questions.zh: 企业如何应对市场对水瓶的需求？

options.en: They cut the bestsellers’ prices like their tumblers.
options.zh: 它们降低保温杯等畅销商品的价格。

options.en: They provide free accessories for the decoration of water bottles.
options.zh: 它们免费提供装饰水瓶的配饰。

options.en: They make bottles in various colors and cooperate with celebrities.
options.zh: 它们推出多种颜色的水瓶，并与名人合作。

options.en: They produce bottles with larger capacity to help the skin glow.
options.zh: 它们生产容量更大的水瓶，以帮助皮肤焕发光彩。

questions.explanation: 第三段明确说企业推出各种颜色的水瓶，还与歌手、电影明星以及梅西等名人合作推出产品。文章未说降价、免费送配饰或靠增大容量改善皮肤。
questions.evidence: Many companies have launched water bottles in all sorts of colors. Meanwhile, they have released collections with pop singers or movie stars.

questions.en: Why are young people so interested in drinking more water?
questions.zh: 为什么年轻人热衷于喝更多水？

options.en: Because they believe it benefits their appearance and mind.
options.zh: 因为他们相信喝水对外貌和精神状态有好处。

options.en: Because French mineral water is cheap and easily available.
options.zh: 因为法国矿泉水便宜且容易买到。

options.en: Because they are urged by national health promotion campaigns.
options.zh: 因为全国性的健康宣传活动敦促他们多喝水。

options.en: Because the government encourages people to drink more water daily.
options.zh: 因为政府鼓励人们每天多喝水。

questions.explanation: 第四段指出年轻人相信水能让皮肤有光泽、思维更敏锐，因此开始喝更多的水；其他原因在文中并未出现。
questions.evidence: Many believe that water is the secret to glowing skin and mental sharpness. This has led to people drinking more.

questions.en: What does the example of Mariah Carey illustrate about drinking fashions?
questions.zh: 玛丽亚·凯莉的例子说明了饮水风尚的什么特点？

options.en: Celebrities usually bathe in mineral water for health.
options.zh: 名人通常为了健康而用矿泉水洗澡。

options.en: Drinking trends can be exaggerated and influenced by celebrities.
options.zh: 饮水潮流可能被夸大，也会受到名人影响。

options.en: Milk is more effective than mineral water for bathing.
options.zh: 牛奶比矿泉水更适合洗澡。

options.en: The trend of hydration inflation will promote bottled water sales.
options.zh: “补水通胀”趋势会推动瓶装水销量。

questions.explanation: 第五段用“凯莉用法国矿泉水泡澡”的传闻与实际用牛奶泡澡作对比，接着说明名人背书促进销量，反映饮水风潮易被夸张传播并受到名人影响。
questions.evidence: Rumours spread that singer Mariah Carey bathed in French mineral water. (She actually takes her baths in milk.) Backed by high-profile endorsement, the products saw a dramatic rise in sales.

questions.en: What can be concluded about the reusable-cup trend of Gen Z?
questions.zh: 关于 Z 世代的可重复使用水杯潮流，可以得出什么结论？

options.en: It is primarily driven by environmental awareness.
options.zh: 这一潮流主要受环保意识驱动。

options.en: It is more about fashion than environmental sustainability.
options.zh: 这一潮流更多与时尚有关，而非环境可持续性。

options.en: It lacks a secondary market for limited-edition cups.
options.zh: 限量版水杯缺乏二级交易市场。

options.en: It is decreasing in popularity among different bottles.
options.zh: 这一潮流在各种水瓶中正逐渐失去人气。

questions.explanation: 末段直接作出总结：尽管 Z 世代具有环保意识，可重复使用水杯的流行仍更多是为了风格和时尚，而不是可持续发展。
questions.evidence: Yet the reusable-cup trend is more about style than sustainability.
